title: org.ligatureprotocol.revocation
description: DRAFT. The payload of a revocation or key abandonment (spec chapters 02 and 07), carried in an envelope signed by the self-signing key of the person named in `person`, which that person's introducers hold. It counts on a device only when that person is the device's owner, or `subject` is that person's own master key (an abandonment), or a verified binding or principal role of that person covers `subject` (ADR 0039).

publicKey.description: A public key as a multibase string with a multicodec prefix (an Ed25519 key renders as z6Mk…).

subject.description: The key no longer trusted: a binding, a principal, a known person, or an abandoned master key.

person.description: The master key of the person making the revocation; the envelope is signed by that person's self-signing key and verified against their person fact.
